WITH matching_movies AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM keyword AS k
    JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
    WHERE k.keyword = '10,000-mile-club'
),
precomputed_links AS (
    SELECT ml.movie_id, ml.link_type_id, ml.linked_movie_id
    FROM movie_link AS ml
    JOIN matching_movies AS mm ON ml.movie_id = mm.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(lt.link) AS link_type,
       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,
       MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM precomputed_links AS pl
JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = pl.link_type_id
JOIN (
    SELECT tt.id, tt.title
    FROM title AS tt
    WHERE tt.id IN (SELECT pl2.movie_id FROM precomputed_links AS pl2)
) AS t1 ON t1.id = pl.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT tt.id, tt.title
    FROM title AS tt
    WHERE tt.id IN (SELECT pl2.linked_movie_id FROM precomputed_links AS pl2)
) AS t2 ON t2.id = pl.linked_movie_id
